pat: Heads-up: customer POC failing. Node + Python sampleapps disagree on embedding length when using batch helper. Node returns padded vectors; Python ends up trimming zeros.

zoe: Any diffs in helper args?

pat: Node helper uses `pad_to`. Python has `pad_len` + `trim_zeros=true` from a refactor. So Python strips trailing zeros after padding.

lee: That will break indexing and NN searches. Also saw rerank `scores` come back as strings from old Python serializer (e.g. "0.87").

sdk-qa: Repro: run both sampleapps, POST mixed-length arrays. Observed Node->512, Python->448 for same input. Also saw duplicate DB rows when retries happen because Python retryer didn't set `Idempotency-Key` header (it used internal `Retry-Id`).

pat: Plan: 1) unify arg name to `pad_to` in python, 2) set `trim_zeros=false` default until parity confirmed, 3) map retryer id -> `Idempotency-Key`, 4) add client-side schema checks: all embeddings in batch must share same dim and rerank `scores` must parse as floats.

zoe: I'll open the python PR and add unit + cross-sdk integ tests (node+python run, random lengths N=100).

ops-bot: deploy: hotfix branch `hotfix/sdk-pad-parity` to staging (build 1367).

sdk-qa: staging run: after patch dims now match and scores normalized, no duplicate inserts in 2000-request stress.

pat: Follow-ups: document `pad_to` in onboarding guide and add CI parity lint to flag mismatched option names across SDKs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
